groupedGdn.planScope: CPU kernels: optimize reductions and exact tiled prefill; runtime attribution: remove repeated validation work while preserving state and rollback.
groupedGdn.change: Six private grouped NEON helpers retain every updated-lane finite predicate in one vector mask and reduce it horizontally once before publication. This covers four/eight-row decode, multi-token prefill and state-only replay. Single-row partial-error publication and scalar failure replay remain unchanged.
groupedGdn.sourceWork: At width 128, update-mask horizontal reductions change from 32/64 to one per four/eight-row helper call. Swift decode across 48 layers, 48 heads and 16 eight-row groups changes this count from 2,359,296 to 36,864 per token. A 32-token eight-row helper changes 2,048 such reductions to one. Key/query result checks and all floating arithmetic retain their order.
groupedGdn.controls: Independent scalar bit oracles, both staging capacities, widths through 256, grouped atomic publication, 1/8/32-token late row/lane failures, NaN, key/update/query overflow and original public-wrapper scalar replay. Existing direct success and refusal controls also passed.
groupedGdn.resources: No new heap allocation or persistent state. Existing conservative stack/scratch admission remains charged; actual generated register pressure, stack and spills remain unmeasured.

validatedDecoderOutput.planScope: Runtime: audit repeated preparation/validation and remove avoidable complete-model work while preserving reusable logits and transactional state.
validatedDecoderOutput.change: An additive Decoder::evaluate_finite_into compatibility method independently validates arbitrary custom output. Native Qwen35 and scoped ProjectedQwen35 carry the graph's existing complete finite-output proof. Runtime checks exact proof pointer, complete output extent and current vocabulary size instead of repeating the finite scan.
validatedDecoderOutput.sourceWork: Omits one 248,320-element / 993,280-byte traversal per Swift final-prompt or generated-token evaluation. State-only ingestion computes no logits and receives no saving from this change. Sampler arithmetic, RNG, output storage and numerical projections are unchanged.
validatedDecoderOutput.controls: Reject wrong-size/nonfinite/partial custom output; reject unrelated static, partial-vocabulary and invalid-tail proofs before sampling or token publication; preserve exact rollback/reuse, hybrid state/logit bits, buffer identity, independent snapshots, late failure and scoped CPU/device-loss behavior.
validatedDecoderOutput.boundary: Public checked construction cannot forge nonfinite values. Borrowed views prevent mutation while live. Only crate-private native overrides consume an existing complete-output proof.

residentPacketGeometry.planScope: Hexagon: reduce repeated preparation in existing bounded multi-operation and multitoken resident submissions.
residentPacketGeometry.change: Serialize each distinct validated row/solver geometry once within an existing native-Q2 packet. Copy only populated immutable descriptor spans and relocate every offset, buffer/tensor index and operation reference. Shared columns and every handle/arena/activation extent are validated before descriptor writing.
residentPacketGeometry.sourceWork: For an eight-member packet sharing geometry, full construction occurs once instead of eight times. Reused members omit 29 checked geometry-field conversions, copy 187 immutable bytes and write 38 relocation bytes. The resulting 225 written bytes equal the original sparse writer; the rejected initial 400-byte copy would have written 438 including relocation. Additional descriptor reads may erase benefit and require measurement.
residentPacketGeometry.controls: 120 complete-frame comparisons against the original scalar serializer across 2/3/4/8 members, 2048/4096 command regions, 128/384/6272 columns, mixed geometry/solver/arena and shared/distinct activations. Five malformed later-member cases preserve untouched bytes. Existing multi-arena/fused-frame and runtime sibling-tail controls passed.
residentPacketGeometry.resources: Packet-local reuse adds no retained template, handle growth or allocation. Existing resources, output poisoning, submission order, operation limits, signed kernels and vendor ownership are unchanged. No DSP call occurred.
